text:
Ellen: Hi team  first-week logistics Q: I'm remote and overlap with EU mornings only. What's the preferred way to handle async updates vs scheduling short syncs?
Tom: welcome Ellen :wave: Short answer: async-first. Post daily stand summaries to your team channel (1-2 bullets), schedule meetings only when you need real-time pair debugging.
Ellen: where do I post the daily summary? a thread in the team channel or #new-hires?
Tom: always in your team channel under a pinned weekly thread. If it's onboarding-specific or asks ops, cross-post to #new-hires. Pin the summary template to the thread.
Ellen: sweet. any recommended template?
Tom: 2 bullets: "Done" and "Blocked/ask" plus timezone. Example: "Done: finished env setup. Blocked: npm token access (cc @ops-bot). TZ: PDT (I overlap EU 09:00-12:00)."
onboarding-buddy: Also drop a one-line "I'm online" note when you'll be around for pairing that day. Helps avoid pinging across zones.
Ellen: got it. bot noise — can I snooze specific channels during overlap-free hours? I don't want to miss team pings but want quiet overnight.
Tom: use `/snooze channels #channel1,#channel2 22:00-07:00` or set in Preferences -> Do Not Disturb and enable channel notification exceptions for high-priority channels like #oncall.
Ellen: good to know. where are bot command cheatsheets?
Tom: pinned in #devex and #new-hires. Quick link: https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/bot-cheats.
ops-bot: Note: urgent security alerts will override snooze if subscribed. To change subscriptions: `@ops-bot list-subscriptions` then `@ops-bot unsubscribe <type>`.
Ellen: thanks ops-bot. last etiquette question: when someone posts a long log, should I reply in-thread or open a ticket?
Tom: reply in-thread with a short ack (:eyes:) and a one-line summary, then move large artifacts to gist/drive and link. If it needs follow-up, create a ticket and link it in the thread.
Slackbot: Tip: pin important how-tos in channel details so new hires can find them quickly.
Ellen: amazing, this clarifies a lot  appreciate the quick help :thumbsup:
Tom: welcome aboard Ellen  we'll set up a quick overlap sync later this week.
Ellen: perfect, talk soon!
